scientific_integrity: The argument is an exact finite-field proof for all prime powers q congruent to 1 modulo 9. Computations check finite examples without claiming infinite verification. The character-sum and prior cyclotomic-mapping criteria are credited.
scientific_limitations: Counts coefficient functions with values in the cubic-residue subgroup only; does not cover unrestricted index-three orthomorphisms. An older full-enumeration article was available only by abstract and may contain an implicit restricted comparison; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Exact rotation bias in cubic-residue scalar complete permutations
